def forward(self, x, **kwargs):
        all_spikes = {}

        q, s_q = self.q_proj(x)
        k, s_k = self.k_proj(x)
        v, s_v = self.v_proj(x)
        f, s_f = self.f_proj(x)
        g, s_g = self.g_proj(x)
        all_spikes.update({'q': s_q, 'k': s_k, 'v': s_v, 'f': s_f, 'g': s_g})

        if self.use_short_conv:
            q, _ = self.q_conv1d(q)
            k, _ = self.k_conv1d(k)
            v, _ = self.v_conv1d(v)
            f, _ = self.f_conv1d(f)

        q = rearrange(q, 'b l (h m) -> b h l m', h=self.num_heads, m=self.num_slots)
        k = rearrange(k, 'b l (h m) -> b h l m', h=self.num_heads, m=self.num_slots)
        v = rearrange(v, 'b l (h d) -> b h l d', h=self.num_heads)
        f = rearrange(f, 'b l (h m) -> b h l m', h=self.num_heads, m=self.num_slots)

        last_state = None
        o, final_state = gsa_chunkwise(q, k, v, f, chunk_size=64, initial_state=last_state)

        o = rearrange(o, 'b h l d -> b l h d')
        o = self.g_norm(o)

        g = rearrange(g, 'b l (h d) -> b l h d', h=self.num_heads)
        o = o * F.silu(g)

        o = rearrange(o, 'b l h d -> b l (h d)')
        o, s_o = self.o_proj(o)
        all_spikes['o'] = s_o
        return o, None, all_spikes

class SpikingMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, d_ffn, dropout=0.1, neuron_type='sdn', surrogate_function=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = SpikingLinear(nn.Linear(d_model, d_ffn), neuron_type, surrogate_function)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc2 = SpikingLinear(nn.Linear(d_ffn, d_model), neuron_type, surrogate_function)

    def forward(self, x):
        x, spike1 = self.fc1(x)
        x, spike2 = self.fc2(self.dropout(x))
        return x, spike1, spike2

class SpikingResidualGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model: int, neuron_type: str, surrogate_function):

def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, attention_mask=None, past_key_values=None, use_cache=False, output_attentions=False, **kwargs):
        all_spikes = {}
        batch_size, q_len, _ = hidden_states.shape
        last_state = None
        if past_key_values is not None and self.layer_idx is not None and len(past_key_values) > self.layer_idx:
            last_state = past_key_values[self.layer_idx]

        cu_seqlens = kwargs.get('cu_seqlens', None)
        if attention_mask is not None:
            indices, cu_seqlens, _ = get_unpad_data(attention_mask[:, -q_len:])
            hidden_states = index_first_axis(rearrange(hidden_states, "b s ... -> (b s) ..."), indices).unsqueeze(0)

        qk, spikes_qk = self.qk_proj(hidden_states)
        q, k = qk, qk
        v, spikes_v = self.v_proj(hidden_states)

        all_spikes['qk_proj'] = spikes_qk
        all_spikes['v_proj'] = spikes_v

        if self.use_short_conv:
            conv_state_q, conv_state_k, conv_state_v = None, None, None
            if last_state is not None:
                conv_state_q, conv_state_k, conv_state_v = last_state['conv_state']

            q, conv_state_q = self.q_conv1d(x=q, cache=conv_state_q, output_final_state=use_cache, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens)
            k, conv_state_k = self.k_conv1d(x=k, cache=conv_state_k, output_final_state=use_cache, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens)
            v, conv_state_v = self.v_conv1d(x=v, cache=conv_state_v, output_final_state=use_cache, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens)
        else:
            if self.qk_activation == 'silu':
                q, k = F.silu(q), F.silu(k)
            v = F.silu(v)

        q, k = map(lambda x: rearrange(x, '... (h d) -> ... h d', d=self.head_k_dim), (q, k))
        v = rearrange(v, '... (h d) -> ... h d', d=self.head_v_dim)

        if self.qk_activation != 'silu':
            if self.qk_activation == 'relu':
                q, k = q.relu(), k.relu()
            elif self.qk_activation == 'elu':
                q, k = elu_p1(q), elu_p1(k)
            elif self.qk_activation != 'identity':
                raise NotImplementedError

        beta = torch.ones_like(q[..., 0])

        if self.allow_neg_eigval:
            beta = beta * 2.

        recurrent_state = last_state.get('recurrent_state', None) if last_state is not None else None
        q = rearrange(q, 'b l h d -> b h l d')
        k = rearrange(k, 'b l h d -> b h l d')
        v = rearrange(v, 'b l h d -> b h l d')
        beta = rearrange(beta, 'b l h -> b h l')

        g = rearrange(g, '... (h d) -> ... h d', d=self.head_v_dim)
        g = rearrange(g, 'b l h d -> b h l d')
        g = F.silu(g)
        v = v * g

        projected, s_in = self.in_proj(x)
        all_spikes['in_proj'] = s_in

        k = rearrange(B, 'b l (h d) -> b h l d', h=self.num_heads)

        spikes_list = []
        x_cont, spikes1 = self.proj_in(avg_activity)

def forward(self, x, past_key_values=None, layer_idx=None, **kwargs):
        all_spikes = {}

        q, s_q = self.q_proj(x)
        k, s_k = self.k_proj(x)
        v, s_v = self.v_proj(x)
        f, s_f = self.f_proj(x)
        g, s_g = self.g_proj(x)
        all_spikes.update({'q': s_q, 'k': s_k, 'v': s_v, 'f': s_f, 'g': s_g})

        if self.use_short_conv:
            q, _ = self.q_conv1d(q)
            k, _ = self.k_conv1d(k)
            v, _ = self.v_conv1d(v)
            f, _ = self.f_conv1d(f)

        # Aggregate spike activity for modulation
        mean_spikes_q = s_q.float().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        mean_spikes_k = s_k.float().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        mean_spikes_v = s_v.float().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        aggregated_spikes = torch.cat([mean_spikes_q, mean_spikes_k, mean_spikes_v], dim=-1)

        # Apply spike modulation to f (decay)
        if self.use_spike_f_modulation:
            f_mod_raw, s_f_mod = self.spike_f_mod_proj(aggregated_spikes)
            f_mod = torch.sigmoid(f_mod_raw)
            f = f * (1 + f_mod)
            all_spikes['f_mod'] = s_f_mod

        # Rearrange for multi-head processing
        q = rearrange(q, 'b l (h m) -> b h l m', h=self.num_heads, m=self.num_slots)
        k = rearrange(k, 'b l (h m) -> b h l m', h=self.num_heads, m=self.num_slots)
        v = rearrange(v, 'b l (h d) -> b h l d', h=self.num_heads)
        f = rearrange(f, 'b l (h m) -> b h l m', h=self.num_heads, m=self.num_slots)

        last_state = None
        if past_key_values is not None and layer_idx is not None:
             if len(past_key_values) > layer_idx:
                 last_state = past_key_values[layer_idx].get('recurrent_state')

        o, final_state = gsa_chunkwise(q, k, v, f, chunk_size=64, initial_state=last_state)

        if past_key_values is not None and layer_idx is not None:
            if len(past_key_values) <= layer_idx:
                past_key_values.append({'recurrent_state': final_state})
            else:
                past_key_values[layer_idx]['recurrent_state'] = final_state

        o = rearrange(o, 'b h l d -> b l h d')
        o = self.g_norm(o)

        g = rearrange(g, 'b l (h d) -> b l h d', h=self.num_heads)
        if self.use_spike_g_modulation:
            g_mod_raw, s_g_mod = self.spike_g_mod_proj(aggregated_spikes)
            g_mod = torch.sigmoid(g_mod_raw)
            g_mod = rearrange(g_mod, 'b l (h d) -> b l h d', h=self.num_heads)
            g = g * (1 + g_mod)
            all_spikes['g_mod'] = s_g_mod
        o = o * F.silu(g)
